Green-white border is soft and difficult to resolve; mountain is small and abruptly seated. Uneven-looking dark lid seam, disconnected-looking small front fittings and weak grounding shadow merit review.

Dark brown underside and cavity obscure internal detail. Rear gap and layered/uneven rim strips at front-left and rear-right make attachment and join quality uncertain. Full model fits, slightly right-weighted.
